text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! Orfevre!!
Orfevre!! Orfevre!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —The common people sing the name of the king.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
All the frenzy and adoration belonged to one person alone.
The sole monarch who reigned over the turf.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You pray—to the King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —And yet.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Why has the curtain fallen? Why has the festival slipped from my grasp? Why...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —The light is not where it should be...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Phew—...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa... It's Orfevre-san.
So beautiful~...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...She's amazing too, isn't she?
The girls in 'Project L'Arc'...
I really look up to and respect them so much.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
!
...I know.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Especially <chrname>-san!!
She can definitely win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
! Exactly! I'm certain the only reason
Venus Park came to the last Representative Match
was to scout her out!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to become like <chrname> too.
I have to do my best...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Venus Park—...
<chrname>—...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —That name again.

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text:
Who's heading to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe this year!?
Will <chrname> make the national team!?
And will Venus Park return for the National Team Exchange Race!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible... What a magnificent race...!"
"Venus Park! We love youuu!!"
"Her name is..."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Once again, that name—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Does it generate... heat?

text_block_list.name: VR Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Is that all the rentals scheduled for today?
Then, like usual, please clean the VR Umalator—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Step aside. We shall enter.

text_block_list.name: VR Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Orfevre-san?!
Huh? ...Wha-?! What should we set the weather and track conditions to?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Prove that head of yours isn't just for decoration.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. What a bizarre contraption.
No matter how many times I see it, it remains suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Even this clinging air, this heat.
Despite knowing it's nothing more than an imitation—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――...Heh.
Haha...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...This turf, too, clings to me with spiteful tenacity."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: Salut!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
You, Orfevre.
I know you, the Japanese Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Why are you here? Weren't you in Franceâ

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm training for the next Representative Exchange!
The machine Satake gave me is very useful!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Are you here to train too?
Fufu♪ Me too!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "You want to beat <chrname> too, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Ha.
Heh... heheh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"You dare call me the challenger?
You dare say *I* am the one looking up to the heavens, of all people?"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes!
Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... Pfft.
Hahaha... Ahaha-ha-ha-ha!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nay, nay, nay... NAY!!!
None other than these legs shall engrave the natural order!
I shall fulfill the royal road! That and nothing else!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, Orfevre burst into the Trainer's Office with a slam of the door.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> and your companion.
Rejoice, for I shall decide the battlefield for our decisive clash.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: At the next Representative Match, I shall personally bring you down.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—There only needs to be
one throne for the people to look up to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A challenge laid bare.
Faced with such chillingly grim words,
we had no choice but to accept.
